summary: VCI Global announced via Form 6-K that its subsidiary V Gallant entered a definitive Share Sale Agreement to acquire 70% (14,000 ordinary shares) of PT Fine Carbon Credit Indonesia for $65,000, payable in V Gallant consideration shares (60M Class A shares with 1 vote each and 5M Class B shares with 20 votes each). The deal is contingent on V Gallant completing a NASDAQ listing within 12 months; otherwise, either party may rescind. A rescission right exists for material breach within 12 months post-completion. No board recommendation or advisor named. Watch for NASDAQ listing progress and regulatory approvals.
